mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 1.0% in 2 months indicate sharp consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 1.0% in 2 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 1.0% in 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates late-cycle expansion where corporate profits are strong, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% and CPI inflation above 2.5% year-over-year signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 700,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production growth (INDPRO < -0.5%) and real GDP growth (GDPC1 < -0.5%) signal severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate < -0.5% and GDPC1 growth rate < -0.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 growth rates are below -0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05.
